args.summary: Deploy of v2.3.1 to production caused checkout-api to fail health checks with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status: healthy in all regions, error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the cause of the failure is identified and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. Verified afterward: the service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
